summary.text: Mark Renholzberger is the Libertarian candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 97 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Justin Moed (D).

paragraphs.text: Renholzberger has run for the same seat before as a Libertarian: he finished third in the November 2020 general election with 816 votes (4.7%) and third again in November 2024 with 429 votes (2.8%), both times behind Moed and the Republican nominee.
He also ran for Indianapolis City Council District 18 in 2023, losing the November general election to incumbent Kristin Jones.
He advanced from the Libertarian Party convention for District 97 on March 22, 2026.
